## Optional build inputs (2)

Not in this repository and never downloaded by it: compiled in only when the build sets the option (official releases do). Each input attributes its own files.

| Input | Option | Title | Author | Licence | Source | Attribution | Used for |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `craft-i18n` | `CRAFT_I18N_DIR` | Interface translations: the craft-i18n catalogs (locales/<code>/common.tsv and pdfcraft.tsv) of the 34 languages PdfCraft offers besides English | The craft-i18n translators, including every translator of PdfCraft's former in-repo catalogs (crates/ui-egui/src/i18n/*.tsv, migrated at pdfcraft@ecdd1e6) | MIT OR Apache-2.0 | https://github.com/storytold/craft-i18n (pinned by commit in craft-i18n.rev, which CI, releases and the flatpak manifests read) | https://github.com/storytold/craft-i18n/blob/main/ATTRIBUTION.md | Interface text in languages other than English, embedded by crates/ui-egui/build.rs and looked up through craft-libs' craft-i18n crate; a build without CRAFT_I18N_DIR is English only. Clean-room translations from PdfCraft's English interface labels |
| `craft-fonts` | `CRAFT_FONTS_DIR` | Japanese fonts: BIZ UDPGothic (Regular, Bold), Shippori Mincho, BIZ UDMincho; native Simplified Chinese font: LXGW WenKai Lite; Arabic font: Noto Sans Arabic | The BIZ UDGothic and BIZ UDMincho Project Authors (Morisawa Inc.), The Shippori Mincho Project Authors (FONTDASU), LXGW and the original Klee Project Authors / Fontworks (LXGW WenKai Lite), The Noto Project Authors (Noto Sans Arabic) | OFL-1.1 | https://github.com/storytold/craft-fonts (pinned by commit in .github/workflows/release.yml and .github/workflows/ci.yml); LXGW WenKai Lite from https://github.com/lxgw/LxgwWenKai-Lite/releases/tag/v1.530 (commit b712c83d98acf977bacfb7fb010207802808bda9) | https://github.com/storytold/craft-fonts/blob/main/ATTRIBUTION.md | Japanese fallback in the interface (BIZ UDPGothic first) and Japanese glyphs in edited PDF text (Shippori Mincho); Simplified Chinese interface fallback on native builds only (LXGW WenKai Lite Regular, font SHA-256 f799a538a3355877e597a0ae04050e897932c9ae7689eb9227c2953c5dd549ea, OFL SHA-256 0333a85fe077b6849f8e417acc44e8bd879442ceb681e271acf93e2d57fd4e2e, read from fonts/simplified-chinese-manifest.txt and never embedded on wasm); Arabic interface text, file names and document titles (Noto Sans Arabic); status captions of named-layer signatures in Arabic, Japanese, Thai and Devanagari, drawn as filled outlines into the display copy by crates/sign/src/status_layers.rs; the web build embeds BIZ UDPGothic Regular and the pinned small Arabic, Hebrew, Thai and Devanagari faces; the selected craft-fonts revision contains no Telugu face. Other non-Japanese CJK faces retain the general 4 MiB cap; the reviewed native-only LXGW fallback has a separate 16 MiB cap. Open-source OFL releases are permitted under current AGENTS.md §1.1 |
